basis.annual: Annual values cover one complete evaluable UTC calendar year; partial observed periods are never extrapolated.
basis.carbon_absorbed: Compatibility metric: associated wind direct operational CO2. No atmospheric carbon removal, lifecycle emissions, or displaced-generation benefit is represented.
basis.carbon_shifted: Signed MWh times risk-hour minus makeup-hour average CO2 intensity under the supplied factors' accounting convention. eGRID-sourced rates exclude biogenic CO2 and allocate CHP emissions to electricity; they do not represent total physical stack CO2. Positive means lower attributed makeup emissions; negative means higher. This is a conserved-energy scenario, not a causal dispatch estimate.
basis.wind: Flexible-load energy scenario in evaluable high-wind/low-price hours; actual wind curtailment and local deliverability are unobserved.

shift.reason: No shift observations or schedule supplied
